# W3C vc-di-eddsa test vectors

From https://github.com/w3c/vc-di-eddsa/tree/main/TestVectors (retrieved 2026-10-14), W3C Software
and Document License. Used to check that the signing path reproduces the published eddsa-rdfc-2022
`proofValue` and canonical N-Quads.

| File | Source |
|---|---|
| `keyPair.json` | `TestVectors/keyPair.json` |
| `employmentAuth.json` | `TestVectors/employmentAuth.json` |
| `signedDataInt.json` | `TestVectors/eddsa-rdfc-2022/employ/signedDataInt.json` |
| `canonDocDataInt.txt` | `TestVectors/eddsa-rdfc-2022/employ/canonDocDataInt.txt` |
| `proofCanonDataInt.txt` | `TestVectors/eddsa-rdfc-2022/employ/proofCanonDataInt.txt` |
| `citizenship-v4rc1.json` | the `https://w3id.org/citizenship/v4rc1` context the vector uses |
